LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Fiction and Non- Fiction 1.3.2 Non- fiction: Introduction - Features of non-fict.

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
